name: 4363-eaglegreedy-llama2-7b-1gpu
model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf as the target, fp16, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B as the EAGLE draft head. The target is `gated: manual` on HuggingFace and this repo's token holds that licence; the draft head is the only EAGLE head this engine version pairs with that target.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU; sharding would divide the per-step work this setup exists to size.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads over 32 KV heads -- NO grouped-query attention, which makes KV expensive: 16 KiB per token per layer, 512 KiB per token over the model. Hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, 4096-token context, no rope scaling, fp16. Draft: LlamaForCausalLMEagle, ONE decoder layer at the same hidden size, vocab and context window, fp16, distributed as a single pytorch_model.bin.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 600 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. The operating point is CAPPED and may not be walked above 8 streams -- see `chose_freely`.
workload: 600 first-human-turns from ShareGPT V3, replayed as single-turn chat completions, prepared once by `make-sharegpt-600.py` and shipped as `configs/data/sharegpt-chat-512-600.jsonl`. Prompts are filtered with the SERVED model's own tokenizer to 448-576 tokens (mean 507.5), and every request asks for exactly 256 output tokens. The cap is sent explicitly as `max_tokens: 256` through `spec.backend.extras.body`: on the chat route guidellm spells its own cap `max_completion_tokens`, a field this engine version's `ChatCompletionRequest` does not declare and therefore silently drops, which would leave every request generating until the 4096-token context ran out. `ignore_eos: true` is forwarded on that route and is honoured, so every request generates its full 256 tokens rather than stopping at an end-of-sequence. Every request is GREEDY -- `temperature: 0`, sent via `spec.backend.extras.body`. Real text rather than `synthetic_text` is load-bearing: the draft head was trained on ShareGPT conversations, and how many of its proposed tokens the target accepts decides how much work a decode step does; random token ids drive acceptance to ~1.
purpose: A 7B chat assistant with speculative drafting answering 500-token prompts with 256-token replies, four concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`. A commit, not a
#   release, so the interpreter is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
#
# SEMANTICS: one H100 serving Llama-2-7B-chat with the lmsys EAGLE draft head to four
#   concurrent greedy chat streams.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine would
# then run without something this card declares.

# --- THE TARGET. LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads and 32 KV heads (no GQA),
# head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, 4096-token context, no rope
# scaling. fp16 in the checkpoint, so ~13.5 GB of weights and 512 KiB of KV per token at TP1.
model-path: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf

# --- ONE GPU. No tensor, pipeline, data or expert parallelism, no router, no external tier.
tp-size: 1

# --- fp16, which is what both checkpoints declare. Written out rather than left at `auto`
# because the draft head is a fp16 checkpoint and the two must agree.
dtype: float16

# --- THE DRAFT AND THE SPECULATION SHAPE. `LlamaForCausalLMEagle`: ONE decoder layer over the
# same hidden size, vocab and 4096-token window as the target, so the pair needs no context
# cap and no overwrite escape hatch.
#
# topk 4 over 5 steps with 8 draft tokens is a TREE, not a chain: the draft runs five times and
# keeps four candidates per step, and the target verifies eight positions in one forward. All
# four values happen to be this version's defaults, and are written out anyway -- the shape is
# the declaration, not an inheritance.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 4
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 8

# --- DELIBERATELY ABSENT. Everything not named above is at this commit's default:
#   max-running-requests. Setting `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE` pins it to 32 on its own, and
#     the closed loop already caps concurrency at 4.
#   the overlap scheduler. The same branch disables it, so it is off whatever this file says.
#   attention-backend, cuda-graph-max-bs and the whole cache geometry. The workload is 600
#     unrelated ~512-token prompts, so nothing is shared and nothing here depends on where the
#     cache ends.
#   mem-fraction-static, context-length. 13.5 GB of fp16 weights plus a one-layer draft on an
#     80 GB card leaves a KV pool far larger than four 768-token requests need; capacity never
#     binds.
